profile.research_note:
Facility referenced only in a tier-4 aggregator; not independently confirmed by Verizon own materials. Current operator status uncertain given Verizon 2017 Equinix divestiture of legacy assets. Revisit with fresh WebSearch budget.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This facility, described as the Verizon Hillsboro, or Tanasbourne, Data Center, is located in Hillsboro, Oregon, a Portland suburb that has become one of the Pacific Northwest most significant data center hubs, home to major facilities operated by companies including QTS. Verizon Business is the enterprise services division of Verizon Communications, headquartered in New York City. This facility was found referenced primarily in a data center tracking aggregator rather than a dedicated Verizon owned publication, so its capacity, construction history, and current operational status were not independently confirmed from a tier one or two source. Verizon has periodically divested legacy data center and colocation assets, including a 3.6 billion dollar sale of 29 data centers to Equinix that closed in 2017, so the current operator of any specific legacy Verizon branded facility should not be assumed without direct confirmation. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
